transcript.text: My Hotpoint washer dryer isn't drying properly any more and there's a funny smell when it's on the dry bit. Is there something I should clean?

Yes, please start by cleaning the lint filter and checking the condenser. Unplug the machine first. Remove the small rectangular filter at the bottom front (you may need a shallow tray for water), rinse it under the tap until clean, then locate the condenser panel behind or beside it, open it, and vacuum out any fluff from the fins before closing it securely. The 'funny smell' is very likely lint scorching on the heating element because airflow was restricted. Cleaning these parts often fixes both the smell and the drying issue. If you find they are already clean, please let me know how large the load was (a dryer handles about half the weight of a wash) and whether the drum felt hot during the cycle.

I usually dry a full wash load, about 8-9kg, in one go. The top of the machine feels very hot to touch, and the smell is like burning dust or scorched fabric. I think I saw a faint haze near the door seal once, and I've still been using it. I didn't know the filter needed cleaning, and I'm not sure whether mine has a condenser.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. Please stop using the machine immediately. A 'burning dust' smell combined with the top of the unit feeling very hot suggests lint has built up inside and may be scorching or smouldering on the heating element, especially since you are drying 8-9kg loads which is well over the safe limit for a dryer (usually around 6-7kg max). While cleaning the external filters is good practice, it will not clear lint that has accumulated deep inside the casing where the heat source is. Because there is an active fire hazard and potential internal damage, you must have this inspected by a qualified engineer before using it again.
